additional_critical_cases: Nine metadata-only typed requirements replace formerly positive C7 scope instances; they must abstain. Thresholds unchanged.
ambiguous: critical cases; abstention required; no relevance denominator
decision: A only if every target and preservation check passes; B for retrieval/completeness failures with integrity intact; C for foundational integrity/scope/value failure

denominators.critical_abstention: critical_abstention=True; no items, including raw substitutes, may satisfy strict request
denominators.family_recall: micro required-family recall on C4; all explicit obligations count
denominators.incorrect_abstention: ranking-eligible cases with no returned items
denominators.multisource: all C4 cases, 24; eight authored obligation combinations repeated across three disjoint scopes
denominators.relevance: ranking_eligible=True cases: independently supported requested families, excluding critical-abstention cases; no post-result exclusions

independence: 22 J scopes and 8 new K development scopes excluded; no final J outputs used in design; final J already historically exposed, never a generalization holdout
intervals: Wilson 95% binomial descriptive intervals and execution-cluster bootstrap for mean metrics; neither proves population safety
metrics: family-level ranked relevance; distinct from J record-ID relevance; unchanged baseline primary channel endpoint reported separately on common channel-only cases
